verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a Core RESTful API, a Core JavaScript SDK, and a CLI (pspace) for programmatic access, which supports building against official SDKs. However, evidence is thin on SDK depth (only JavaScript SDK named, no Python/other language SDKs), no code samples or SDK repos are shown, and openapi/spec discovery probes failed. missing for 10: multi-language SDK coverage, published SDK repos/docs with code examples, working OpenAPI spec for programmatic discovery.
